221:       subroutine calczg(tn,o2,o1,n2,he,z,zg,lon0,lon1,lev0,lev1,
222:      |  lat0,lat1)
223: !
224: ! Given geopotential z (calculated with the model constant gravity),
225: !   calculate geopotential zg with varying gravity. This is taken from
226: !   tgcmproc_f90, routines calchts and glatf in proclat.F.
227: ! ZG will be put on secondary histories, along with the regular Z.
228: !
229:       use params_module,only: dz,glat
230:       use init_module,only: istep
231:       use cons_module,only: boltz,avo
232:       use addfld_module,only: addfld
233: !
234: ! Args:
235:       integer,intent(in) :: lon0,lon1,lev0,lev1,lat0,lat1
236:       real,dimension(lev0:lev1,lon0-2:lon1+2,lat0-2:lat1+2),intent(in)::
237:      |  tn, ! neutral temperature (deg K)
238:      |  o2, ! molecular oxygen (mmr)
239:      |  o1, ! atomic oxygen (mmr)
240:      |  he, ! helium (mmr)
241:      |  n2, ! molecular nitrogen (mmr)
242:      |  z   ! geopotential calculated with constant gravity (from addiag)
243:       real,dimension(lev0:lev1,lon0-2:lon1+2,lat0-2:lat1+2),
244:      |  intent(out) ::
245:      |  zg  ! output geopotential calculated with varying gravity
246: !
247: ! Local:
248:       integer :: i,j,k
249:       real :: g0,r0,c2
250:       real,dimension(lev0:lev1) :: xmas,g
251:       real,parameter :: dgtr=1.74533E-2
252: !
253: ! Latitude scan:
254: ! 1/20/10 btf: changed float(j) to glat(j) in cos of c2 calculation
255:       do j=lat0,lat1
256:         c2 = cos(2.*dgtr*glat(j))
257:         g0 = 980.616*(1.-.0026373*c2)
258:         r0 = 2.*g0/(3.085462e-6 + 2.27e-9*c2) ! effective earth radius
259: !
260: ! Longitude scan:
261:         do i=lon0,lon1
262:           g(1)=g0*(r0/(r0+0.5*(z(1,i,j)+z(2,i,j))))**2
263:           xmas(:) = 1./(o1(:,i,j)/16.+o2(:,i,j)/32.+he(:,i,j)/4.+
264:      |                  n2(:,i,j)/28.)/avo
265: !
266: ! Interface levels:
267:           zg(lev0,i,j) = z(lev0,i,j)
268:           do k=lev0+1,lev1-1
269:             zg(k,i,j) = zg(k-1,i,j) + boltz*dz*tn(k-1,i,j) /
270:      |        (xmas(k-1)*g(k-1))
271:             g(k)=g0*(r0/(r0+0.5*(zg(k,i,j)+z(k+1,i,j))))**2
272:           enddo ! k=lev0+1,lev1-1
273:           zg(lev1,i,j) = 2.0*zg(lev1-1,i,j)-zg(lev1-2,i,j)
274:         enddo ! i=lon0,lon1
275: !
276: ! Save ZG to secondary histories:
277: ! PLEASE DO NOT COMMENT THIS OUT -- ZG IS A MANDATORY FIELD ON SECH HISTORIES
278: !
279:         call addfld('ZG','Geometric Height ZG',
280:      |    'cm',zg(:,lon0:lon1,j),'ilev',lev0,lev1,'lon',lon0,lon1,j)
281:       enddo ! j=lat0,lat1
282:       end subroutine calczg
